methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly for each vendor on 2026-06-15: precoro.com/pricing/, tradogram.com/pricing, spendwise.com/pricing, procuredesk.com/pricing/, procurify.com/pricing/, fraxion.biz/pricing/, kissflow.com/procurement/pricing/, and order.co/procurement-software/. Coupa's pricing/product pages returned 403; quote-only status and compliance were confirmed via web search citing official Coupa compliance pages. Published flat/per-seat prices were captured verbatim; 'starts at' figures for Precoro and Tradogram reflect minimum annual billing (shown as monthly-equivalent). Quote-only vendors (Procurify, Order.co, Coupa, Kissflow, Fraxion) have monthlyUsd=null. Compliance is asserted true only when explicitly stated on a vendor security/compliance page; otherwise null. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Precoro
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from precoro.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-15 (Core $499/mo, Automation $999/mo, AP Module $499/mo, all 'starts at' billed annually; Enterprise custom). Compliance fetched from precoro.com/security/ which explicitly states GDPR, UK GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, CCPA, and HIPAA.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: Starts at $499/month billed annually; includes purchase requisitions, POs, receipts, invoices, 2- and 3-way matching, automated approvals, custom fields/workflows, item/service catalog, vendor management, contract repository, expense management, QuickBooks Online/Xero/Slack integrations, mobile app. Tier-based user limits.

plans.name: Automation
plans.notes: Starts at $999/month billed annually; everything in Core plus intelligent AP automation, e-invoicing, intake management, inventory, PunchOuts, AI document scanning, vendor onboarding, supplier portal, RFPs, real-time budget tracking, AI assistant, advanced integrations, API access, SSO.

plans.name: AP Module
plans.notes: Starts at $499/month billed annually; standalone AP module covering invoice management, intelligent AP automation, e-invoicing, budget management, AI expenses, payments, AI assistant, vendor management, accounting integrations, API access, SSO, mobile app.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing billed annually; unlimited users, advanced admin controls, ERP integrations, custom integrations, regional server selection (US/EU), IP whitelisting, enterprise-grade data protection.

limits: Core and Automation plans have tier-based user limits; unlimited users only on Enterprise
Pricing listed as 'starts at' — actual cost depends on user count
enrichment.provenance: Pricing and compliance re-verified directly from precoro.com/pricing/ and precoro.com/security/ on 2026-06-15. Security page explicitly lists SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA.
